status: frozen before development policy scoring and held-out LLM inference
task: Learn an additive Fourier correction to UFF against published QM single-point energies on constrained-relaxed QM torsion geometries
split: qm_data.py scaffold hash; parent dedup; pilot identities and pilot ring scaffolds excluded
planner: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 4-bit, one constrained next-token decision per molecule; same plan reused for all seeds; frozen development-only in-context examples
rule: driven bond amide-like or conjugated -> orthogonal_focus; otherwise both ends aromatic -> cis_focus; otherwise uniform
primary: Molecule-mean trapezoidal error-query AUC / query interval / centered baseline test residual RMSE, averaged over five seeds
secondary: Final centered test residual RMSE and baseline-normalized final RMSE; absolute RMSE/AUC reported too
inference: Paired molecule effects; scaffold-cluster bootstrap 10000 draws; 97.5% two-sided CIs for each of two primary comparisons (LLM versus Bayes, LLM versus rule); improvement requires upper bound below zero for both
few_shot_rule: For each strategy, choose at most one development example with largest mean normalized-AUC gap to runner-up and positive gap; append feature-only example and best action. All candidate strategies are available to rule and fixed baselines.
limitations: Held out from this project's development, not guaranteed absent from LLM pretraining
QM sources were used to fit Sage; UFF is used here to avoid claiming Sage-training exclusion
Acquisition replay is not force-field MD validation
One-dimensional complete 24-point scans only; scaffold/QM family bias
